description: This Java class 'PaymentWorker' provides utility methods for handling payment-related operations in the OFBiz framework, including retrieving payment methods, calculating totals, and managing payment applications.

classes.name: PaymentWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for payment processing in OFBiz.

methods.name: getPartyPaymentMethodValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of payment method value maps for a given party, optionally including old payment methods.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodAndRelated
methods.description: Fetches payment method and related entities (credit card, gift card, etc.) from the request and delegator.

methods.name: getPaymentAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the primary payment address for a party.

methods.name: getPaymentsTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount from a list of payment entities.

methods.name: getPaymentApplied
methods.description: Calculates the total amount applied to a payment, with options for actual currency.

methods.name: getPaymentAppliedAmount
methods.description: Returns the applied amount converted to the payment's currency.

methods.name: getPaymentNotApplied
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount not applied to a payment.
